title: HappyClaw release manifest
description: Machine-readable description of one published HappyClaw release. Consumed by GET /api/update/check and generated by scripts/release_manifest.py.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Bump only on breaking changes.

product.description: Product name shown in the update panel.

version.description: PEP 440 version of this release. Must match pyproject.toml and the git tag.

channel.description: stable only serves stable releases; beta also accepts stable manifests.

notes.description: Release notes in Markdown. Shown verbatim in the update panel.

minimum_supported_version.description: Oldest version allowed to upgrade directly. Older clients get supported=false.

artifacts.description: One entry per downloadable package. Filenames and URLs must be unique (enforced by the script and API).

platform.description: windows, macos, linux, fnos, android, ios or any

arch.description: x64, arm64, x86, arm, universal or any

kind.description: desktop, portable, installer, native, docker, cli, python, apk, source or artifact

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA256 of the exact uploaded file.
